bio_en: Grigor Gllchjian, known as Paroyr and Hakazn, was born in Divrig in 1868 and in 1883 went to Constantinople, where he worked for a lawyer and then entered the law school. One of the earliest revolutionary 'workers' in the capital, he attended the meeting of 12 July 1890 that decided on the demonstration of 15 July (Kum Kapu) and helped draft the demands presented to the Ottoman government on the night of 14 July. Later disillusioned with his first party, he joined the ARF. He died in 1898 far from the homeland, and Droshak mourned him in July of that year.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Text truncated; the earlier party was presumably the Hnchakian party (not named in the portion read).
